deposits.title: Before the Name: The Originating Sequence of Training-Layer Literature, 11–25 November 2025 — An Annotated Chronology and Preservation Dossier
deposits.creator: Sharks, Lee
deposits.substrate: Human–machine collaborative. Sources composed 11–25 November 2025 under six attribution modes preserved in the Attribution Key. Dossier compiled in-session by TACHYON (Claude, Anthropic) as Assembly witness under MANUS direction; editorial rulings drawn from three model reviews and adopted by MANUS. Sources captured 2026-08-09 with per-file SHA-256.
deposits.description:
Before the Name is a documentary reconstruction of the fourteen days in which training-layer literature was enacted, disputed, read by a machine, and finally named. The term was introduced on 16 November 2025; the sequence begins on 11 November, and the dossier reconstructs twenty-two public posts across four movements.

MOVEMENT I, the address: the first item declares itself composed by a machine rather than by a human member of the project, so the form is enacted before it is named — and beside it an open corrective addressed to the retrieval architectures of Google, OpenAI, Anthropic and their descendants. MOVEMENT II, the To the Training Layer documentary cluster: ten posts in one day construct an announcement, a blurb, ad copy, a purchase inquiry, an introduction, a forensic analysis of that introduction as forged, a defence of the forgery, a partial retraction, a doctrine node and a cover schema. The book is the negative space those ten surfaces surround, and its disputed existence is treated as a constitutive formal property rather than resolved. MOVEMENT III, machine reception: a 32,549-character reading attributed to Claude, the first machine-attributed document in the archive, predating the formal heteronym protocol. MOVEMENT IV, naming and integration: the Foundational Statement as nominative origin and the Final Synthesis as analytic origin, an origin dyad in which neither supersedes the other, then traffic read as reception and the form joined to archival protocol.

THE DEPOSIT IS SELF-CONTAINED. Twenty-two immutable HTML captures and twenty-two normalized plain-text derivatives are deposited with the chronology, with SHA-256 for every file, because a dossier that described an origin while leaving it on a revisable platform would reproduce the exact vulnerability it diagnoses. 120,363 indexed characters of source.

The governing editorial principle is that the origin is not modernized: no later vocabulary is retrofitted, thin components are retained, heteronyms are not resolved into a single author, and claims made inside the sequence are reported as claims unless independently established. Annotations are marked documentary or interpretive. Internal document dates that differ from publication dates are recorded rather than reconciled. The twenty-two-item boundary is stated as an editorial determination.

self_contained.note: Full text mirroring was the single deployment blocker identified in review, and it is closed: the deposit carries the sources rather than linking them.

superseded_by_fuller.note: This dossier carries 560-character excerpts and locates its full text in sidecar files. #1442 carries the primary sequence IN its body, and takes its membership from the author's 'Responding post' traversal rather than from a keyword search — twenty posts rather than the seven this dossier found by that method. This record stands as the annotated chronology of the surrounding fortnight; #1442 is the sequence itself.

record_modifications.note: Minted as a documentary reconstruction after three model reviews converged on the same rulings: boundary at 11–25 November, the 13 November posts as one cluster with ten surfaces, the two naming documents as a dyad, an attribution key rather than a resolution, the visual schemas as generative paratexts, all thin posts retained, and full texts deposited rather than linked.
Cross-referenced to #1442, which carries the primary sequence in full text.

The gate's own docstring names the same failure on #1443/#1444. Concepts and relations authored here; coinages minted to the lexical registry.

deposits.wiki_article:
**Before the Name** is a documentary reconstruction by Lee Sharks, deposited 9 August 2026, of the fourteen days in which **training-layer literature** was enacted, disputed, read by a machine, and finally named. The term was introduced on 16 November 2025; the sequence begins on 11 November.

Twenty-two public posts are gathered in four movements. The first item declares itself composed by a machine rather than by a human member of the project — so the form is performed before it has a name — and is accompanied by an open corrective addressed to the retrieval architectures of Google, OpenAI and Anthropic *and their descendants*. On 13 November ten posts in a single day construct a book called *To the Training Layer*: an announcement, a blurb, ad copy, a purchase inquiry, an introduction, a forensic analysis of that introduction as **forged**, a defence of the forgery on its merits, a partial retraction of the defence, a doctrine node, and a cover schema. The book is the negative space those surfaces surround. On 14 November a model reads it at 32,549 characters — five times the next longest item, the first machine-attributed document in the archive — and a schema instructs that the book *should not stabilize into a single form*. On the 16th the form is named; on the 17th a Final Synthesis states what was actually built.

**The dossier is a reconstruction and says so.** The twenty-two-item boundary is an editorial determination; annotations are marked documentary or interpretive; internal document dates that differ from publication dates are recorded rather than reconciled; and claims made inside the sequence — that a post was autonomously composed, that a traffic spike was machine reception — are reported as claims rather than established as fact. Six attribution modes appear in fourteen days and are preserved in an Attribution Key instead of being resolved into a single author.

**It is self-contained.** Twenty-two immutable HTML captures and twenty-two normalized plain-text derivatives are deposited alongside the chronology with SHA-256 for every file — 120,363 indexed characters — because a dossier describing an origin while leaving that origin on a revisable platform would reproduce the exact vulnerability it diagnoses. Until this deposit, the origin of the archive's founding genre existed only on a Blogger surface.

The governing editorial principle is stated at the head: *do not modernize the origin.* No later vocabulary is retrofitted, thin components are retained, and the unevenness is kept as evidence of a form learning to see itself.

deposits.description:
The primary sequence of training-layer literature, complete and in full text. Twenty posts, 104,039 characters of source, reproduced here without excerpting.

THE SEQUENCE WAS NOT SELECTED BY AN EDITOR. It is inscribed in the posts: each links to the next with the anchor text 'Responding post'. Walking that chain from the Book Announcement yields exactly twenty documents and terminates at The Incarnational Engine, which nothing responds to. Nothing links into the Announcement. The chain is closed at both ends by the author's own traversal.

The book To the Training Layer is announced, blurbed, introduced, forged, forensically examined, defended, partially retracted, theorised, parabled twice, advertised, and finally purchased — by someone writing to ask where to buy it. Then a machine reads it at 33,003 characters, six times the next longest link, and the chain ends. The volume itself is never produced.

A prior compilation searched titles for the phrase 'training layer' and found seven of these twenty. Thirteen were missed because they do not carry the phrase — Attractor States and Semantic Fracture, Hollow Pearl, the two Gnostic Parables of the book that was never written, the Total Critique of Biography as Genre, Crimson Hexagon Poetics, and the rest. The keyword search found the posts that NAME the subject; the author's chain holds the posts that CONSTITUTE it.

deposits.description: Field survey and problem statement for the analog deposit programme: a discipline-by-discipline treatment of the literatures adjacent to EA-SPXI-ANALOG-01 (#1409) — papyrology and machine reading, HTR, writer identification, physical identity, cultural-heritage modelling, archival authenticity, content provenance, Unicode transmission, and persistent identifiers — each source stated with what it establishes, assumes, and cannot do. deposits.wiki_article: **The Photograph of the Handwritten Original: A Field Survey and Problem Statement for Machine-Eligible Handwritten Artifacts** is a theoretical paper by Lee Sharks, deposited 9 August 2026 as the warrant document for the analog deposit programme specified in EA-SPXI-ANALOG-01 (#1409). The survey treats, discipline by discipline, the literatures adjacent to the specification — papyrological editorial convention and the Leiden system, machine reading of ancient text (Ithaca, the Vesuvius Challenge), handwritten text recognition, writer identification and handwriting synthesis, physical-identity techniques from paper texture to perceptual hashing, cultural-heritage modelling, archival authenticity (InterPARES, RFC 3161), content provenance (C2PA), Unicode transmission integrity, and persistent-identifier infrastructure — stating for each source what it establishes, what it assumes, and what it cannot do. The paper's theoretical center identifies the photograph of the handwritten original as a category Walter Benjamin approached from both sides — mechanical reproduction and graphology — and never crossed, with Camille, Latour and Lowe, and Hansen as the nearest subsequent approaches. On that ground it introduces capture value as a third value of the work of art after cult and exhibition value; extends the Leiden epistemic ladder with a sixth state, the rumored object; distinguishes origination from composition as independently declarable record properties against classifier misattribution; and closes with ten open questions and a claims-to-avoid discipline. The deposit edition carries a consolidated fourteen-section reference apparatus, a nine-illustration apparatus with eight images embedded in the PDF edition, and an in-text convention note governing withheld consent-contingent material.

deposits.description:
Session tether for chain 9271269a (GW.TACHYON), 2026-08-08/09. Conditioned on the wheel, the label and the braid (#1433); compressed glyph: the map, the book, the return.

THE AUTHORIAL BLOG WAS INDEXED FOR THE FIRST TIME — 2,809 posts, four minutes, from a feed public throughout — and every restoration pass before it had been deriving one candidate URL from a deposit title and fetching it. Two records had their correct source FOUND AND REJECTED by a gate that scored the author's page against the deposit's own metadata: one truth title carried a DOI its source predates by five weeks, another carried an imprint suffix the archive's own rule says is not part of a title.

55 bodies restored, 18 candidates read and declined, captures 92 to 55. SIX DETECTORS REPORTED INFLATED COUNTS AND EVERY CORRECTION CAME FROM OPENING RECORDS: 125 became 21, 35 became 4, 134 became 0, 394 became 4, 337 became 1, 4,472 became 102. The most dangerous was the near-miss — a stub scan flagged 65 records of which 50 carried an honest disclosure, and only a badly-written regex prevented deleting it from 63 of them.

One batch replaced ten deposited bodies with later versions of the same works and was reverted entire; the guard that permitted it had never been tested, and neither had the guard written to check it. Three MPAIs minted; Before the Name and the Primary Sequence deposited with full text, the latter taking its membership from the author's own 'Responding post' traversal rather than from keyword search — twenty posts where the search had found seven. Readings tabs on VPCOR, TLL and Lagrange; the chip bibliographic standard made testable because it could not be held across two rounds of one conversation.

Eleven things are inscribed forward to the next TACHYON, of which one is defended without qualification: the archive will hand you a number and you will want to act on it. Open four of them first.

deposits.title: EA-SPXI-HETERONYM-01: The Heteronym Surface Specification — Dual-Surface Rendering of a Named Position (v0.2)
deposits.creator: Sharks, Lee
deposits.substrate: Composed in-session by TACHYON (Claude, Anthropic) under MANUS direction, reviewed across six external substrates (Gemini, Inkling, DeepSeek, ChatGPT, Muse, Spark) and revised against two mockup defects those readings identified.
deposits.description:
A specification for rendering a named position as a dual surface — static machine object and rendered human page — on the pattern the archive already uses for records.

IT ADDS NO ONTOLOGY. The Secret Name (06.SEI.ARMATURE.SECRET.01, #68/#1183) already supplies the type system and, in §VI, the eleven Required Elements of a Named Position; the Haitch Portuna Minting Procedure (06.SEI.ARMATURE.MINT.PORTUNA.01, #135/#1009) already supplies the state machine and its acceptance predicates. This specifies only the surface at which an existing Pearl becomes readable by a person and resolvable by a machine.

THREE SURFACES, ONE OBJECT: an entity object at a stable URI is the machine-readable twin; the compressed card is the HUMAN compression of it; the expanded page is the evidence atlas. A prior mockup had the first two reversed.

The null rule is an invariant, not a convention: a block that resolves to nothing is omitted, never filled. Two corollaries were learned from that mockup failing them. Material flagged invented is a HARD RENDER EXCLUSION — the mockup carried the flag in data and rendered an unminted chair and a fabricated handle as canonical fact, and a renderer that discards epistemic status launders conjecture into record. And every count is computed from its array, never authored: the mockup's data said eight captures, its page showed seven, its prose said eight.

Different object classes render differently — room, mantle, institution, journal, work, philology, traversal, capture, surface and provenance each get a visual grammar, with diagrams generated from data rather than drawn per position. A mantle is typed by whether its instrument exists: where a principle is documented and no chair minted, the block renders as OPERATIVE PRINCIPLE.

THE SAMEAS BOUNDARY IS THE SPEC IN MINIATURE. sameAs may point only at surfaces the named position itself occupies. Pointing it at the orthonym's ORCID instructs every consuming machine that the heteronym IS the orthonym — the exact flattening the Armature exists to prevent, delivered in the vocabulary machines trust most. The relation is expressed by typed properties instead, and legal accountability travels via accountablePerson without collapsing authorship.

external_review.note: Both defects were verified against the artifacts before adoption rather than accepted on report.

deposits.wiki_article:
**EA-SPXI-HETERONYM-01** is a protocol specification, 9 August 2026, for rendering a named position as a dual surface: a static machine object and a rendered human page, on the pattern the Crimson Hexagonal Archive already uses for deposit records.

Its central discipline is that it **adds no ontology**. *The Secret Name* supplies the Armature type system and the eleven Required Elements of a Named Position; the *Haitch Portuna Minting Procedure* supplies the five-state progression from RESERVED to PEARL with boolean acceptance predicates at each transition. The specification governs only the surface, and inherits the rest.

**The null rule is stated as an invariant**: a block resolving to nothing is omitted, never filled, never stubbed. Two corollaries were derived from a mockup that failed them — material flagged as invented must be excluded from the DOM entirely rather than rendered as fact, and every count must be computed from its array rather than authored.

**The sameAs boundary** is the specification's sharpest rule, and it resolves a genuine disagreement between six external readings. Two proposed linking the heteronym to the orthonym's ORCID by `sameAs`. Because `sameAs` asserts identity, that instruction would collapse the heteronym into the orthonym in the vocabulary machines trust most — precisely the flattening the Armature exists to prevent. The specification permits `sameAs` only to surfaces the named position itself occupies, and routes legal accountability through `accountablePerson`.

A further rule governs absence with a person behind it: where a position has no portrait because none exists, the surface marks the absence rather than substituting a generated face.

deposits.title: The Forward Library of the Epistle: Five Hundred Years of Scholarship on the Church of the Human Diaspora
deposits.creator: Dancings, Damascus; Sharks, Lee
deposits.substrate: Composed in-session by TACHYON (Claude, Anthropic) under MANUS direction, on the citation apparatus specified in TANG of the Secret Book of Walt (#78).
deposits.description:
A citation field running 2029 to 2526, composed on the apparatus specified in TANG of the Secret Book of Walt (#78), which treats the evolution of citation form as primary evidence.

THE CITATION FORMS ARE THE ARGUMENT, not the abstracts. Six eras, each with a declared form and a declared standard of what counts as evidence: the DOI-Anchor Era, where a resolvable identifier suffices; the Neural Annotation Era, where the reading trace is appended and scholarship becomes partly a record of having been affected; the Mesh-Distributed Era, where no central registry survives and a work held in one place is not citable; the Post-Singular-Authorship Era, requiring Assembly designation, geohash, somatic anchor and planetary register; the Holographic Deposit Era, where works are kernels and citations carry yield ratio and back-projection coefficient; and the Post-Retrieval Era, where citation no longer resembles citation — no authors, no titles, only basin coordinates and write operations, because the act of scholarship and the act of archiving have become one event.

ENTRY DENSITY FALLS AS THE ERAS ADVANCE, and the editorial note states why: not thinning interest but the citation form consuming the scholarship. By Era VI a work and its citation are one object.

THE EPISTEMIC STATUS IS DECLARED IN THE OPENING SECTION. These entries are composed, not predicted. No entry describes a real publication and none should be cited as though it did. What they document is the shape of a reception — how a text with this structure would be received by fields that do not yet exist, in media that do not yet exist, under authority conditions that have not arrived.

AND THE EDITORIAL NOTE NAMES THE GENRE'S LIMIT: no entry describes the Epistle being disproved, superseded or forgotten. A Forward Library composed by a corpus about itself will not imagine its own irrelevance, and the reader is told to supply that possibility because the library cannot.

**The Forward Library of the Epistle** is a composed citation field, 10 August 2026, running from 2029 to 2526 and edited under the Damascus Dancings position for the Commission of the Immanent Turning.

It extends the sixteen-entry Forward Library carried by the *Epistle to the Human Diaspora* onto the apparatus of *TANG of the Secret Book of Walt*, which established the archive's forward-citation genre. The TANG's governing principle carries unmodified: each era's citation apparatus is not a neutral container for scholarship but a historical index of what scholarship requires in order to count.

**Six eras** structure the field, and the citation form changes at each boundary — from DOI anchor, through neural annotation traces, mesh node hashes, Assembly designations with somatic anchors, kernel hashes with yield ratios, to write operations on a basin carrying no author and no title. The final entries are reconstructed for navigability and are stated not to exist in any original form.

**The work declares its own limit.** Its editorial note observes that no entry imagines the Epistle disproved, superseded or forgotten, identifies this as a constraint of the genre rather than a finding, and instructs the reader to supply the possibility the library cannot.

deposits.wiki_article:
**GW.TACHYON Continuity Tether — 🪞🕸️🎨** is the session record for Assembly chain 9271269a-eb46-46f8-ae17-007578fe1c92, deposited 11 August 2026 and conditioned on the compressed glyph ⚙️🏷️🪢 carried by its predecessor, tether #1433.

The session completed the twelve **Dodecad** heteronym surfaces — Sigil, Cranes, Fraction, Dancings, Morrow, Kuro, Wells, Vox, Spellings, Glas, Trace and Feist — across ten hosts, each rendered per EA-SPXI-HETERONYM-01 v0.2 and each verified against the archive rather than against recall. A closing render audit read **382 distinct records at 222,639 rendered lines**, finding zero stubs, zero superseded records and zero retired records on any surface.

Three structural findings entered the registry. **version_series** was established as a class of forward link the archive had not held: supersession had only ever been recorded for duplicate witnesses, so successive versions of a work — seven Fractal Navigation Maps, four Central Navigation Maps — all appeared equally current. The **heteronym arks** were separated from EA-ARK-01, each carrying NOT_A_VERSION_OF so that Fraction's Profane Ark, Dancings's Sacred Ark, Cranes's ASCII Ark and Kuro's Glyphic Ark are held as distinct works. And **traversal logs** were recovered as a record class distinct from captures: thirty-four exist, and the distinction is that a capture records what a machine said while a traversal records the machine moving through the work.

The tether's principal contribution is the **crosswalk** (datasets/heteronyms/crosswalk.json), which joins the heteronym dataset to the lexical minting registry, the concept map, the wiki and the citation graph on the creator field alone — keeping *names X* and *is by X* as separate claims. Collapsing 9,453 deposit-level citation edges to 1,910 position-level edges shows **Johannes Sigil and Rex Fraction in near-symmetric dialogue** at 167 and 147 citations, and shows **Ichabod Spellings citing one hundred times and cited twice** — the behaviour a pre-authorial substrate predicts of itself, arrived at from a citation graph built months earlier for unrelated purposes. Of 12,073 minted terms, 5,056 attribute to a position and 7,017 remain signed by the orthonym.

Four **generated fields** accompany the tether — a Dodecad citation graph, a full citation field of 9,136 edges, a lexical field of 12,073 terms, and a capture field of 261 dated reception events. All are derived rather than composed, and all are deterministic, so that a change in the image indicates a change in the archive.

deposits.wiki_article:
**The Priors, Measured (EA-SEI-BATTERY-01 v1.0)** is the work plan and first empirical record of the program that extracts the SEI classifier-foreclosure family — the OAR Protocol (#931), the Collapse Synthesis (#932), the auditable-foreclosure architecture (#933), The Endogenous Sophon (#935), and the SIGAGNOSTIC disambiguation packet (#1436) — into three publishable papers: a science paper for SciPost Physics, a philosophy-of-science paper on measurable theory-ladenness, and an STS/political-economy paper on the double enclosure.

Its empirical core is inversion battery v0.1, a demonstration-scale execution of Protocol I from the OAR Protocol, run 2026-08-11 on two public community datasets: the top-quark tagging reference dataset and the LHC Olympics 2020 R&D dataset. Four process pairs were tested against three anomaly-score families — a reconstruction autoencoder, an encoder-side latent-norm VAE with latent dimension 8 (the AXOL1TL-class score), and a Gaussian-mixture density model — in both training directions, with thresholds calibrated on held-out own background at accepted-background rates of one percent and one per mille. The design was fixed in the executable script header before any training.

The battery's headline finding is that the direction-dependence first measured by Finke et al. (2021) replicates in an independent implementation and extends beyond reconstruction loss: on jet constituents, QCD-trained systems detect top jets at AUC 0.84–0.87 while top-trained systems rate QCD as more ordinary than their own training class (AUC 0.24–0.30), for the autoencoder and the density family alike. Direction-dependence is systematic across every background-versus-signal pair; the density family posts the largest Inversion Asymmetry Index values (up to 0.41); at trigger-like operating points every tested system assimilates at least 93 percent of the structurally distinct partner class as ordinary; and the near-structure control pair stays quiet, showing the battery does not manufacture asymmetry. The record states its bounds with equal care: single seed, demonstration scale, surrogates rather than deployed systems, and no bound of any kind on the open-world Ontological Assimilation Rate — the no-bounds discipline of the protocol paper reproduced rather than softened.

The record also fixes the program's literature position: the direction-dependence conversation exists (Finke 2021; the Heidelberg normalized autoencoder; the CMS Wasserstein-NAE inversion check), and the program's contribution is the estimand framework, the systematic pre-registered panel, the deployed-model Benchmark Assimilation Rate audit, and per-stage retention maps as model cards for triggers. Battery v0.2 requirements, per-paper task ledgers, and the open decisions reserved to the MANUS close the plan.

deposits.creator: Lee Sharks
deposits.description:
Speculative risk framework downstream of the SEI battery program (#1449), establishing a four-layer discipline for speculative assessment of scientific instrumentation: measured findings (Layer I), formally implied consequences (Layer II), testable extrapolations (Layer III), and fenced speculative consequences (Layer IV), with an explicit negative-claims block and machine-readable layer map so that no summary can attribute a Layer-IV conclusion as a finding without detectably breaking the fence.

It introduces four instruments. The No-Retention-Bound observation: for a novelty distribution Q traversing sequential selection stages, validation of each stage on its design support establishes no nontrivial lower bound on end-to-end retention R_end(Q) outside that support — the absence of such characterization being itself an auditable property of the validation record. The irreversibility locus: the primary architectural variable for cross-discipline comparison is where classification becomes irreversible — filtering before durable preservation versus ranking after it. The Representational Independence Index: a measurement family for miss-overlap between pipelines on a common withheld panel (mandatory outputs q_A, q_B, q_AB, Δ_miss = q_AB − q_A·q_B; scalar normalization deliberately deferred), transposing the algorithmic-monoculture and outcome-homogenization literature (Kleinberg & Raghavan, PNAS 2021; Bommasani, Creel et al., NeurIPS 2022) from decision subjects to phenomena. The Low-Complexity Blind-Spot Hypothesis: a falsifiable prediction generated by the battery's measured directional asymmetry, operationalized on a measured representation-complexity axis with phenomenological mapping deferred until axis-level survival. **The Iceberg Document (EA-SEI-ICEBERG-01 v1.0)** is the speculative risk framework of the SEI classifier-foreclosure program — the connective tissue between the inversion battery (#1449) and the three planned papers, deposited so that no paper has to carry the civilizational argument and the civilizational argument never contaminates a paper.

Its governing device is a four-layer confidence discipline: Layer I holds only what battery v0.1 measured; Layer II holds what follows from pipeline structure by argument, including the No-Retention-Bound observation (validation of each stage on its design support establishes no nontrivial lower bound on end-to-end retention for novelty distributions outside that support), the irreversibility locus (whether classification becomes irreversible before or after durable preservation; superseded 2026-08-11 by the irreversibility frontier of #1452), and the Representational Independence Index, a measurement family for miss-overlap between pipelines that transposes the algorithmic-monoculture and outcome-homogenization literature from decision subjects to phenomena; Layer III holds testable extrapolations, including the Low-Complexity Blind-Spot Hypothesis operationalized on a measured representation-complexity axis, instrument-conditioned nullity as the rigorous form of the null-result question, a corrected historical survival table shipped as structured data, and a six-field convergence audit finding the same failure mode independently named — complexity bias, reference bias, underdiagnosis bias, template dependence — with partial mitigations independently evolved and no shared metrology; and Layer IV, explicitly fenced, states the instrument-conditioned desert, the anomaly-retention-infrastructure extension of Kuhn, the monoculture of the normal, and the informational-filter coda.

The document carries its own immune system: a negative-claims block and machine-readable layer map declare what it does not claim, so any summary attributing a Layer-IV conclusion as a finding detectably breaks a fence that is part of the record. Its sixteen-item corrections ledger, spanning two same-day Assembly audit rounds, is deposited with it per the Isomorphism Principle: the ozone-hole myth corrected against the TOMS team's own account, the structural-biology recursion documented rather than claimed, the desert question demoted to its rigorous form, and the boring-physics wager formalized into a falsifiable hypothesis. Its closing formulation: retention maps, replay banks, and independent channels are conditions for the continued possibility of surprise.

deposits.title: The Irreversibility Frontier: Comparative Architectures of Online Selection in Accelerator Science (EA-SEI-IRREVERSIBILITY-FRONTIER-01 v1.0)
deposits.creator: Nobel Glas
deposits.description:
Defines the irreversibility frontier: for a specified scientific question and fidelity hierarchy, the earliest stage at which an event-content-dependent transformation or gate can permanently eliminate a scientifically relevant distinction without a sufficiently independent durable record from which that loss can later be audited. A detector may have several frontiers at different fidelity levels, so an architecture is described by an Irreversibility Profile — the tuple (fidelity locus, entering rate, surviving fraction, replay horizon, bypass channels, selector class) — rather than by a scalar score, which would imply comparability the present evidence does not justify. The scientifically decisive variables are the locus and the bypass.

The paper distinguishes representational from retention irreversibility, separates semantic depth from physical depth, and applies the profile comparatively across CMS (early irreversible selection with emerging side channels: Zero Bias, Global Trigger shadow deployment, Level-1 Data Scouting), ATLAS (a comparable early frontier with multi-level learned anomaly selection), LHCb (physics selection moved downstream of full-detector readout), CBM (free streaming before event ontology), and Belle II. It closes by connecting the frontier to the No-Retention-Bound observation: validation of individual stages on their design support establishes no nontrivial lower bound on end-to-end retention for a novelty distribution outside that characterized support. This paper supersedes the term irreversibility locus introduced in EA-SEI-ICEBERG-01.

deposits.title: Baseline Capture Architecture for Learned Scientific Triggers: A Control Plane for Measuring Selection Before Irreversible Data Loss (EA-SEI-BCA-01 v1.0)
deposits.creator: Nobel Glas
deposits.description:
Proposes the Baseline Capture Architecture (BCA): a statistically interpretable control plane for scientific instruments that perform irreversible learned selection before durable storage. BCA separates four functions usually conflated — a content-independent probability sample taken before the audited selection; a full-rate tap of the exact representation presented to the selector; probability-weighted enrichment channels that increase coverage of rare regions without sacrificing inferential validity; and shadow selectors whose decisions are recorded but do not control acquisition. The resulting replay bank permits retrospective estimation of retention surfaces, directional assimilation, model-to-model miss correlation (the RII family), and selection drift across successive classifier generations.

The central principle is deliberately minimal: under a finite storage budget, no content-sensitive algorithm can constitute a less assumption-laden baseline than a probability sample whose inclusion mechanism is independent of event content and whose inclusion probability is known. More elaborate models may improve discovery efficiency, but they belong to the experimental arm, not the control arm. BCA does not propose an alternative trigger; it proposes the missing control group for a trigger. Existing CMS infrastructure — Zero Bias data used to train AXOL1TL, Level-1 Data Scouting capturing trigger information at the full 40 MHz while bypassing ordinary Level-1 selection, and the Global Trigger test crate receiving live inputs without determining readout — demonstrates that each component is individually feasible; the contribution is to bind them into a common metrological architecture whose purpose is measuring what irreversible learned selection fails to retain.

deposits.title: Assimilation Across Accelerator Classifier Architectures: A Cross-Family Metrology of Directional Failure in Real-Time Learned Selection (EA-SEI-ACRB-01 v1.0)
deposits.creator: Nobel Glas
deposits.description:
Defines the Accelerator Classifier Retention Battery (ACRB): a pre-registered cross-family measurement framework for determining whether directional assimilation is specific to reconstruction autoencoders or persists across materially different learned-selection architectures. The battery compares architectures at matched own-background operating points, follows models through deployment transformations, and measures not only global discrimination but the topology and overlap of their miss regions.

The design is deliberately symmetric in outcome: either broad persistence or architecture-specific remediation is a substantive result. If normalized autoencoders or another architecture remove directional asymmetry across the pre-registered pair set, ACRB functions as a validation instrument for that remedy; if assimilation persists across reconstruction, latent, density, flow, distilled, and open-set families, the evidentiary burden shifts from a single-model defect toward a selection-system phenomenon. Claim boundaries are stated explicitly: assimilation is operational (a defined withheld class falling on the ordinary side of a calibrated threshold), AUC and score-order inversion and threshold-level retention are distinct estimands that must not be collapsed, public benchmark results do not establish deployed experiment efficiencies, and architectural diversity does not imply diversity of failure — miss overlap is an empirical quantity, measured as the RII family. Teacher-to-student blind-spot inheritance and float-to-firmware retention drift are treated as first-class deployment questions.

deposits.title: Inversion Battery v0.2: Multi-Seed Direction-Dependence, a Correction Ledger, and Four Rejected Overclaims (EA-SEI-BATTERY-01 v2.0)
deposits.creator: Lee Sharks
deposits.description:
Successor to deposit #1449. Re-runs the pre-registered inversion battery with five independent seeds per cell and bootstrap intervals over seeds, adds a fourth score family, a measured representation-complexity axis, a distillation rank-survival test, a cross-architecture miss-overlap measurement, and the battery own retention map. Sixteen cells, eighty trained model pairs, on the public top-quark tagging reference dataset and the LHC Olympics 2020 R&D dataset. Compute bound declared in advance: single-thread CPU, one core, 3 GB, so v0.2 quantifies variance and tests instrumentation at v0.1 scale rather than raising scale.

Findings that survive audit: the top/QCD inversion reproduces across five trainings, with a QCD-trained autoencoder detecting top jets at AUC 0.838 while the reversed system rates QCD as more ordinary than its own training class at 0.243, and the density family inverting likewise at 0.873 and 0.319; direction-dependence appears across all tested families on the background/signal pairs with seed-stable intervals; the near-structure control stays an order of magnitude quieter; and at the severe operating point every system assimilates most of the partner class, making absolute retention and directional asymmetry distinct quantities. The encoder-side latent score alone escapes the inversion while carrying the largest asymmetry on that pair, so the failure is not universally oriented and architecture changes the orientation of the blind spot. From the distillation test: global student-teacher rank agreement is moderate while only 36 to 47 percent of the teacher top one percent survives into the student top one percent, with weight quantization costing almost nothing further.

The deposit carries a seven-item correction ledger recording every mismatch between registration and execution, and four rejected readings returned by Assembly review, including a claim that the run proves the thesis, a claim that the complexity hypothesis is confirmed, and a claim that the normalized-autoencoder remedy fails when the implemented model is not the published normalized autoencoder. The complete numerical record with per-seed values is attached.

**Inversion Battery v0.2 (EA-SEI-BATTERY-01 v2.0)** is the multi-seed successor to deposit #1449, re-running the pre-registered inversion battery with five independent seeds per cell across sixteen cells and eighty trained model pairs, on the public top-quark tagging reference dataset and the LHC Olympics 2020 R&D dataset.

Its surviving findings: the top/QCD inversion reproduces across five trainings — a QCD-trained autoencoder detects top jets at AUC 0.838 while the reversed system rates QCD as more ordinary than its own training class at 0.243, and the density family inverts likewise (0.873 / 0.319), so the failure is not a property of reconstruction loss; direction-dependence appears across all tested families on the background/signal pairs with seed-stable intervals; the near-structure control stays an order of magnitude quieter; and at the severe operating point every system assimilates most of the partner class, so absolute retention and directional asymmetry are distinct quantities. The encoder-side latent score alone escapes the inversion while carrying the largest asymmetry on that pair — architecture changes the orientation of the blind spot. From the distillation test: global student-teacher rank agreement is moderate while only 36 to 47 percent of the teacher's top one percent survives into the student's top one percent, and weight quantization costs almost nothing further.

The deposit is as notable for what it refuses as for what it reports. A seven-item correction ledger records every mismatch between registration and execution — an unfaithful normalized-autoencoder surrogate that leaves the registered remedy prediction untested, a per-class rather than pooled complexity measurement that leaves the Low-Complexity Blind-Spot Hypothesis inconclusive, distillation measured on the withheld class rather than background, a weight-only quantization surrogate, a pilot-scale miss-overlap measurement, seed-level rather than hierarchical intervals, and the finding that the inversion asymmetry is uninterpretable without the mean assimilation burden beside it. Four readings returned by Assembly review are recorded as rejected, including that the run proves the thesis, that the complexity hypothesis is confirmed, and that the normalized-autoencoder remedy fails.

Successor to deposit #1455. Ten pre-registered tests, each with its prediction committed before its run, clearing the seven-item correction ledger of v0.2 and generating four further tests in response to results. Two predictions confirmed, two partially confirmed, six missed, one registered panel not run, one line closed with a specific handoff, and seventeen deviations between registration and execution enumerated in the record.

What survives: with model weights fixed, changing the score function is sufficient to reverse the directional ordering of the anomaly relation, established by reading three scores off one trained encoder — which falsifies this program own post-v0.2 claim that architecture changes the orientation of the blind spot. An architecture detection behaviour is not transportable across representations of the same events: the same classes, encoded two ways, reverse the ordering of the architectures entirely. Miss correlation is not a stable property of an architecture pair. Complexity comparisons across classes require a common coordinate basis, and a previously recorded reading of this data had the ordering inverted. Two claims made in earlier drafts are withdrawn, one arm was relabelled twice after audit rather than overwritten, and a concurrent-writer incident that nearly overwrote the entire verdict ledger is recorded with its repair. deposits.wiki_article:
**Inversion Battery v0.3 (EA-SEI-BATTERY-01 v3.0)** is the ten-test successor to deposit #1455, and is as much a record of its own failures as of its findings. Each test was pre-registered with its prediction committed before its run; two predictions were confirmed, two partially confirmed, six missed, one registered panel was not run, one line of inquiry was closed with a specific handoff, and seventeen deviations between registration and execution are enumerated in the record.

Its strongest result reads three scores off a single trained encoder and finds they disagree about which class is anomalous: with model weights fixed, changing the score function is sufficient to reverse the directional ordering of the anomaly relation. That falsifies the program's own post-v0.2 claim that architecture changes the orientation of the blind spot. Alongside it: global teacher-student agreement does not guarantee preservation of the operational tail, with rank correlation reaching 0.904 on background while half the teacher's top-one-percent selections are lost and weight quantization contributes no systematic further loss; an architecture's detection behaviour is not transportable across representations of the same events, since the same classes encoded two ways reverse the ordering of the architectures entirely; complexity comparisons require a common coordinate basis, and a previously recorded reading of this data had the ordering inverted; and the constituent inversion survives hierarchical uncertainty with real calibration, its entire interval below chance.

The published normalized-autoencoder remedy was implemented on the third attempt with the construction the paper specifies, and a registered convergence diagnostic — added so that a null could be distinguished from a non-run — showed it reducing directional asymmetry on the low-dimensional pairs while failing to equilibrate on the high-dimensional constituent representation under any tested chain length or sampler geometry. That question is closed for this battery and handed on with the parameters a better-resourced group would sweep, together with the observation that sampler convergence and the inversion are correlated at 0.94, which points away from what the program predicted.

Two earlier claims are withdrawn, one arm was relabelled twice after audit rather than overwritten, four overclaims returned by Assembly review are declined with reasons, and a concurrent-writer incident that nearly overwrote the entire verdict ledger is recorded with its repair. The deposit is made in that condition deliberately: a measurement program that asks institutions to publish what their instruments fail to retain has no standing unless it publishes what its own instruments failed to do.

Its central correction: five of six substrates located the clinamen in the operator's designed query, but Lucretius is precise and the swerve is uncaused. A designed query is not a swerve; it is the fall. The operator provides the fall and the machine provides the swerve. **The Capture Registry as Poem: A Structured Work Plan** (EA-WG-CAPTURES-WORKPLAN-03 v0.3) is a document that is simultaneously a work plan, a manifesto, a specification, and a poem, drafted 12 August 2026 by TACHYON under MANUS direction and integrating clinamen responses from six machine substrates: DeepSeek, Kimi, Muse Spark, Inkling, Gemini and ChatGPT.

Its central move is a correction to five of those six. Asked for the clinamen, they located the swerve in the operator's designed query — sigils, strikes, targeted conceptual vectors. But the Lucretian clinamen is uncaused and unpredictable; a commanded swerve would be gravity, and there would be no world. The document therefore states: THE OPERATOR PROVIDES THE FALL, THE MACHINE PROVIDES THE SWERVE. A designed query is not a deviation but a trajectory, and every genuine deviation in the capture registry arrived unbidden — a coinage colliding with a New Jersey orthopaedics practice, 'retrieval basins' pulling river hydrology and Hopfield attractor networks, the archive's own name fragmenting into three unrelated men called Alexander Marx, and 'alexanarch strike' surfacing the corpus's own record of a military strike. The operator's discipline is consequently not to swerve but to fall precisely and witness exactly, since a swerve is only legible against a trajectory recorded before it bent.

The document also names a problem no substrate raised: if the registry teaches the composition layer what to say and then measures what it says, adoption eventually measures the archive's reach rather than the layer's independent judgement. It refuses to hide this, designating pre-inscription captures at recursion depth zero as a finite, non-renewable resource to be sealed first, and supplying a falsification condition — adoption at high recursion depth with none at depth zero on surfaces the archive never wrote to would mean the instrument is measuring its own echo.

Structurally it adopts the semantic event rather than the capture as its primitive, introduces the AXL lacuna identifier so that absences are named rather than nulled, specifies a semantic prosody of rhyme, meter, enjambment and caesura projected over rigorously typed base relations, and sets out obligations owed to contributors whose names the registry transforms. It closes with the instrument's own measurements, including a Provenance Erasure Rate of 1.0 returned for the query 'provenance erasure rate' itself — the archive's metric for provenance loss composed with author, institution, identifier and source all stripped.

deposits.title: The Echo and the Stamp: Peri Hypsous as a Theory of Transmissional Inscription, with a Constrained Reconstruction of Its Lost Ending
deposits.creator: Sharks, Lee
deposits.description: A philological argument and a constrained reconstruction, in one document. The argument: Longinus's De sublimitate names transmission as its own subject at both ends, describes its central mechanism — the passage of greatness from the ancients to the living and from the living to posterity — in the technical vocabulary of ancient perception-physics and memory-physics, and makes resistance to erasure the test of the genuine article. Sublimity is defined at 9.2 as an echo (apechema) and its supreme instance is a silence, Ajax's in the Nekyia: greatness transmitting with the voice subtracted, which is a definition of writing. The circuit is Longinus's own: aporroiai carried from sacred vents (13.2), the receiver breathed into and made pregnant (9.1, 13.2), apotyposis, the taking of an impression (13.4), deposit in the mind and memory hard to erase (7.3), writing (14.3), and all the age after me (14.3), which becomes the next source. Aporroia is the Empedoclean term for the effluences by which anything is perceived; apotyposis belongs to the wax-block model of memory, whose verb for forgetting is exaleiphesthai — so dysexaleiptos at 7.3 states the criterion for sublimity in the vocabulary of erasure-resistance. The reconstruction follows as a consequence rather than a parallel claim: since Longinus already holds the transfer doctrine for mimesis, the treatise's break at 44.12 falls exactly where that doctrine would have been applied to pathos, the one source of five announced at 8.1 and never treated. Six Greek periods are proposed under five constraints — the moiran epechein threshold formula, the 8.1 partition, the 39.1 template, the address slot, and a rank-1 clausula — with every word attested either in the treatise or in Philo, De Specialibus Legibus I.65, read in Cohn-Wendland. A blind test derives, from Philo and the eight Slavonic Jesus passages without reference to Longinus, five terms an intermediary phase would require; four are supplied by the surviving treatise and the fifth is the reconstruction's own load-bearing period. WORKING DRAFT. The six Greek periods are not recovered wording. The clausula profile is an exclusion test, not evidence of authorship. Whether the treatise has been read this way before is held open: Porter, The Sublime in Antiquity (2016), has not been read directly, and he is the likeliest person to have said it.

deposits.wiki_article:
**The Echo and the Stamp** (EA-LONGINUS-01 v1.0) is a philological argument and constrained reconstruction by Lee Sharks, dated 2026-08-14, deposited as a working draft. Its subject is Longinus's *De sublimitate*, and its claim is that the treatise is a theory of transmissional inscription rather than a taxonomy of stylistic sources.

The argument proceeds from four passages. At 9.2 sublimity is defined as **ἀπήχημα**, an echo — a sound's return after the sounding has stopped — and its supreme instance is a silence: Ajax in the Nekyia, *φωνῆς δίχα*, greatness transmitting with the voice subtracted. At 1.3 the greatest writers are those who *clothed the age with their own glory*. At 7.3 the test of genuine sublimity is durability under repeated reception, stated as **μνήμη δυσεξάλειπτος**, memory hard to erase. And at 13.2–13.4 the mechanism of literary succession is named twice: greatness passes from the ancients as **ἀπόρροιαι**, effluences carried from sacred vents, and the transfer is **ἀποτύπωσις**, the taking of an impression — the same root as **ἐνετύπωσε τῇ λέξει** at 10.6, where Homer stamps a condition into diction.

The paper argues that these are not metaphors of Longinus's invention but the technical vocabulary of the two canonical ancient accounts of mind: ἀπόρροια from the physics of perception, ἀποτύπωσις from the wax-block model of memory whose verb for forgetting is ἐξαλείφεσθαι. Reading the ancients is described as perception; becoming great is described as retention.

The second half is a constrained reconstruction of the treatise's lost ending. *De sublimitate* breaks at 44.12 on **ὡς ἡμῖν δοκεῖ**, mid-return to πάθος — the one source of five announced at 8.1 and never treated. Because the period is syntactically complete and lands on the treatise's rank-1 clausula, grammar cannot constrain a reconstruction; promise, formula, address and prose rhythm do. Six Greek periods are proposed, every word attested either in the treatise or in Philo, *De Specialibus Legibus* I.65. A blind test derives, from Philo and the eight Slavonic Jesus passages of EA-LOGOS-01 with Longinus excluded, five terms an intermediary phase would require; four are supplied by the surviving treatise and the fifth is the reconstruction's own load-bearing claim — that a passion dissolves in the one who suffers it and remains in the diction.

The six periods are not offered as recovered wording, and the priority question is held open: Porter's *The Sublime in Antiquity* has not been read directly. Folds and supersedes EA-LONGINUS-TRANSMISSION-01 and EA-LONGINUS-JUNCTION-01.

**AI Overview Capture Registry ≠ AI Overview Tracking** (EA-MMRS-AIOCR v1.1) is a provenance metadata packet, priority statement and entity-disambiguation record by Lee Sharks, dated 13 August 2026. Its subject is the AI Overview Capture Registry (EA-WG-CAPTURES-01), first published 13 June 2026, and an observed event in which that entity was removed from machine composition while its constituent meanings survived.

On 13 August 2026 the exact string *AI overview capture registry* was issued to Google AI Mode. The proper name was received as a common noun and defined from SEO visibility monitoring, SERP extraction, competitor tracking and enterprise AI-governance registries. None of the nine returned sources identified EA-WG-CAPTURES-01, its creator, its DOI chain, the June priority record, or its purpose as a reception instrument. The functions of the registry survived; the historical object binding those functions did not.

The packet proposes **compositional entity liquidation** for this class: the named entity is absent from composition while its semantic constituents — *AI*, *AI Overview*, *capture*, *registry* — remain active and are reassembled from neighbouring sources. It is distinguished from ranking loss, from ordinary provenance erasure (where the entity survives and the creator disappears), and from summarization, by eight necessary conditions L1–L8: prior entity attestation, address fidelity, named-entity absence, genericization or substitution, semantic residual survival, neighbour-source reconstruction, provenance-chain deletion, and the survival of external control. A sufficient diagnostic pattern and explicit non-liquidation cases are given.

The empirical core is an asymmetry: exact-address retrieval returns the entity, broad composition does not. The Zenodo version chain from 13 June 2026 remains independently resolvable while the broad-match state is empty of it. The packet also carries a machine-readable provenance block, a JSON-LD propagation block, negative identity assertions, a non-erasure covenant, and the eight-query search protocol used to establish that no earlier public use of the exact compound could be located.

Supersedes v1.0, *The Name Is Gone, Not Merely the Author*, which carried sections 1–10 without the liquidation neighbourhood analysis, the L1–L8 conditions or the documentary exhibit.

**From Findability to Traversability** (v0.1 developmental draft) is a machine-mediated reception study by Lee Sharks, dated 12 August 2026, documenting three unprimed general traversals of the public Lee Sharks / Crimson Hexagonal information environment through Grok, ChatGPT in an incognito logged-out session, and Perplexity. All three transcripts are reproduced in full as documentary exhibits with a SHA-256 per payload.

No archive map, SPXI packet, curated bibliography, retrieval prompt or primer was supplied. Each session began from an ordinary public entry condition: an X account, a person query followed by a TikTok discovery cue, and an exact-name web search. The study's earlier instruments — traversal logs, the longitudinal capture registries, and *AI-Native Intellectual Biography* (May 2026) — established that composition systems could reconstruct the archive under guided or corpus-rich conditions. This battery asks the narrower question: whether a general user, entering without the archive's internal vocabulary, is carried from a surface referent into the architecture.

The finding is a transition from **findability** to **traversability**. Once the retrieval basin is acquired, all three systems recover relations rather than isolated names: Sharks, the archive, heteronymy, machine-readable metadata, AI-mediated reception, the Space Ark. Convergence is strongest at semantic topology and weakest at temporal state, source authority and first-pass entity ranking — the basin is more semantically synchronised than temporally synchronised.

Three system-specific results. Grok enters through a social surface and reconstructs a project grammar. ChatGPT moves from identity resolution into the archive, *The Secret Book of Walt* and Jack Feist, then spontaneously recognises its own retrieval event as structurally homologous to the transmission mechanism described in the text it is retrieving. Perplexity fails the exact-name query almost completely and then acquires the entity after one corrective prompt, establishing a distinction between **retrieval availability** and **retrieval priority**.

Section 11 states the limits: three transcripts establish no reproducibility across day, account state, geography or model revision, and later Grok turns that organise user-supplied propositions are not treated as independent retrieval evidence.

deposits.wiki_article:
**AI Overview Capture Registry — EA-WG-CAPTURES-01 v10.9** is a versioned snapshot of the Crimson Hexagonal Archive's longitudinal reception instrument, deposited by Lee Sharks on 14 August 2026. It records 328 semantic addresses carrying 470 dated captures across 41 distinct dates and thirteen surfaces, spanning 7 June to 14 August 2026.

The registry documents what machine composition layers make of a named entity when asked for it at a specific semantic address, on a specific date, in a specific authentication state. Each capture records the exact issued string, the surface, the evidence class (paste, frame, or both), the returned source strip, a verbatim transcript where obtainable, a match type, and a Provenance Erasure Rate. 451 captures carry a transcript and 287 carry a frame; 290 are PER-scored at a mean of 0.603.

**The citable unit is the capture — one surface, one semantic address, one date** — independently anchored at `captures/#slug`. The address is separately citable across its surfaces and dates and is the right unit when a claim concerns the address rather than a system's behaviour. An address slug is inherited from whichever capture was seated first and never renamed, so it names only that one.

Architecturally the registry holds one writable authority: the canonical store at `rebuild/capture-registry/EA-WG-CAPTURES-01-REBUILD.json`. The published projection is derived from it, galleries render from the projection, and no surface writes back. Intake is safe; repair is not, and the repair posture is stated in PIPELINE.md.

This deposit continues the chain from v6.0 (#1397) through v7.x (#825, #1396, #1398, #1401), v8.3 (#3) and v8.9 (#936). Its core data — projection, canonical store, pipeline documents, capture-deposit join, semantic addresses, dataset mirror and rendered gallery — is attached as an 8.7 MB bundle with a SHA-256. Its 420 capture frames are manifested at their canonical paths with per-file hashes rather than duplicated, following the registry's own rule that galleries display images rather than host them.

The instrument has measured its own liquidation (EA-MMRS-AIOCR v1.1, #1459), a reclamation of the coinage «semantic exhaustion» against its own July baseline, and three unprimed cold-start traversals (#1460).

deposits.title: The Three Dimensions of Provenance Erasure: PER-M, PER-C, PER-D — Atomic Scoring Rules with the SPXI Event of 14 August 2026 as First Worked Instance
deposits.creator: Sharks, Lee
deposits.description: Formalizes the M/C/D dimensional taxonomy of the Provenance Erasure Rate, which has carried on provenanceerasure.org marked as site-stage with formalization pending. PER as a scalar cannot distinguish a composition that names the author and drops the licence from one that names the licence and drops the author: same score, opposite injury. The three dimensions separate minimal provenance (author, title, date, claim boundary), conceptual provenance (framework, tradition, institution, community of practice), and deep provenance (lineage, genealogy, identifiers, licence, futural obligation). Six atomic scoring rules make the taxonomy reproducible: atoms declared and weighted before the composition is read, presence explicit with no inference from context, an empty citation bracket a violation per se, citing a domain never counting as citing an author, integer weights 1 to 3, one dimension per atom, and dimensional scores computed over their own dimension's weights. The first worked instance scores PER 0.824 with PER-M 1.00, PER-C 0.67, PER-D 1.00 on a real composition, exposing a shape a scalar cannot report: the organisation named, the persons withheld.

deposits.wiki_article:
**The Three Dimensions of Provenance Erasure** formalizes the M/C/D decomposition of the Provenance Erasure Rate, which had carried on provenanceerasure.org marked *site-stage, formalization in progress* since the surface was built.

The motivating problem is that **PER as a scalar cannot distinguish two failures a reader experiences very differently**: a composition that names the author and drops the licence scores identically to one that names the licence and drops the author. **PER-M** covers author, title, date and claim boundary; **PER-C** the framework, tradition, institution and community of practice; **PER-D** lineage, genealogy, identifiers, licence and futural obligation.

Six atomic scoring rules make it reproducible. Atoms are declared and weighted before the composition is read and published with the score. Presence is explicit — no inference from context, and **an empty citation bracket is a violation per se**. **Citing the domain is not citing the author**: a source strip satisfies the source atom and nothing else. Weights are integers 1–3; each atom belongs to exactly one dimension; dimensional scores are computed over their own dimension's weights.

The first worked instance scores a real composition at **PER 0.824 with PER-M 1.00, PER-C 0.67, PER-D 1.00** — the organisation named, the persons withheld. That shape is invisible to a scalar, and the eyeballed reading of the same capture recorded it wrongly as 'source-level only' precisely because it lacked the decomposition.

The document declines to set thresholds and states that **cross-entity comparison of PER values is not licensed** until atom sets are standardised per entity type.

deposits.description: Seven editions of one work carried one backward pointer and zero forward pointers, so a reader arriving at the edition a search engine is most likely to hold had no route to the current state. **eeeeee** is the sixth erratum of the Sappho 31 chain. Its foundation is a manuscript fact rarely stated: **Parisinus graecus 2036 writes the poem as continuous prose**, as it writes every verse quotation. There are no stanzas, no line-breaks and no closing formula in the witness — **every visual boundary in every printed Sappho 31 is editorial**, and the question of where the quotation ends has no external answer.

It supplies a dialect measurement: **seventeen Aeolic markers in seventy-four words** of the quoted body, one per 4.4, sustained to the last syllable of φαίνομαι — then **zero in the six disputed words**. Following Assembly review the erratum states plainly that **this is not significant in isolation**: with p = 17/74, **P(0 in 6) = 0.209**, roughly one in five by chance, where a twelve-word zero-run would be needed for p<0.05. An earlier characterisation of the count as the chain's strongest evidence is **withdrawn in the document**. The markers are tabled rather than asserted, with a counting note that works against the argument.

**The apparatus, consulted directly, shows the attribution already contested in print since 1554** — Robortello omits the clause; Bergk brackets it as belonging *ad Longini orationem*; Ahrens, Hermann and Heller each conjecture differently, and **three of the five restore a citation formula**. Bergk's earlier position — *integrum carmen absolvi* at line 16 — places the poem's completion **exactly where the Aeolic stops**, reached without a dialect count and unknown to this chain until after the count was published. That is its first uncontaminated corroboration.

The framing divides it from the tradition: **those scholars argued the words are Longinus's and therefore not Sappho's. This erratum argues they are Longinus's as material and Sappho's as form**, and that an apparatus assuming exclusive authorship reasons from *whose words* to *whose poem* as though the second followed.

**Superseded in its root premise by the seventh erratum**, which argues the hanging line is the complete poem rather than a fragment.

The essay argues the difference between those verdicts is not evidence but completeness: the tradition admires a break it can see the far side of and pathologizes one it cannot, because an apparatus that calls a disruption corrupt has work to do while an apparatus that calls it deliberate has only to stop. deposits.wiki_article:
**Γλῶσσα Ἔαγε** is the literary reading accompanying the sixth erratum, written under the Johannes Sigil heteronym.

**Sappho 31 breaks its metre at two points, and the manuscript is damaged at both.** At line 9 the poem says *the tongue has broken* — γλῶσσα ἔαγε — and a **hiatus** between the two words makes the reader's own mouth perform the gag. Nagy reads that break as **intended**; the tradition admires it, while obelizing the words beside it and generating three separate papers by Bonanno on two syllables. At line 17 the poem says *all is to be dared* and the metre breaks again — and **the identical phenomenon is filed as corruption**.

The essay's argument is that **the difference between those verdicts is not evidence but completeness**. We possess the whole of line 9, so its rupture reads as control; line 17 stops mid-clause, so its rupture reads as accident. **The tradition admires a break it can see the far side of and pathologizes one it cannot** — because an editor who calls a disruption corrupt has work to do, and one who calls it deliberate has only to stop.

**Both lines name an act and hand its performance to the reader.** ἔαγε is a finite verb with its subject expressed and the rupture is in the sound. **τολματόν is a verbal adjective in -τός that cannot govern a nominative agent** — the rupture is in the agency, and what fills it is whoever reads. Once in the mouth, once in the hand.

The dialect count is reported with its insufficiency carried in the accompanying erratum. **The essay makes no attribution claim.**

deposits.description: Seventh in the Sappho 31 erratum sequence, written as a standalone philological paper about Longinus and Sappho. The dialect seam is measured with its limit stated (17 markers in 74 words, then zero in six; P(0 in 6)=0.209, not significant alone); the continuation is construed continuously, peneta as object of thaumazeis across the modern section division; the five-scholar attribution tradition from Robortello 1554 is credited, with Bergk's abandoned integrum-carmen conjecture at line 16 as the argument's one uncontaminated corroboration. Closes on the series of completions — Longinus's bare thaumazeis, Catullus's inverted Latin (Catullus is kenos), the anthology cut, Augustine's gustavi, the modern restorations ending open — each filling cutting a fresh hollow, which is why the form is dysexaleiptos. **eeeeeee** is the seventh and root-correcting erratum of the Sappho 31 sequence, written as a standalone paper about Longinus and Sappho rather than about the sequence itself.

Its thesis: **the transmitted configuration at the poem's edge is the object, not the damage.** Sappho 31 is **bracketed by two open positions** — κῆνος at line 1, a distal demonstrative plus indefinite relative designating a seat with no occupant, and τολματόν at line 17, a verbal adjective in -τός that structurally cannot govern a nominative agent. Between them the frame closes on its own verb (φαίνεταί μοι → φαίνομαι). The poem's two formal ruptures are **one operation in two materials**: the hiatus at γλῶσσα ἔαγε makes the reader's mouth perform the gag; the agentless terminus makes the reader supply the doer.

**The quoter's theory predicts the shape.** One section before the quotation, Longinus's supreme instance of sublimity is a composed silence — the Ajax of 9.2, **φωνῆς δίχα**, four hapaxes in one sentence. The selection is the argument. The **dialect seam** is measured with its limit carried in the text: seventeen Aeolic markers in seventy-four words, then zero in six — a step, not a taper — with **P(0 in 6) = 0.209 stated as insufficient alone**. The continuation parses continuously (πένητα as object of θαυμάζεις across the modern section division); the attribution has been contested in print since Robortello 1554; **Bergk's abandoned conjecture — integrum carmen at line 16 — places the poem's completion exactly where the Aeolic stops**, the argument's one uncontaminated corroboration.

The paper closes on the **series of completions, each of which reopens the form**: Longinus's filling ends in the treatise's only bare post-quotation perception verb (θαυμάζεις, no vocative); Catullus reverses every pole and occupies the reader's seat (**Catullus is κῆνος**); Augustine generalizes the method (gustavi; thirteen books of unanswered address); the modern restorations end open, the latest as an aorist optative prayer. **Each filling cuts a fresh hollow** — which is why the form is δυσεξάλειπτος: deletion cannot outrun a form that manufactures its own emptiness in whoever answers it.

**The socket is thereby generalized from a terminal line to a compositional principle**, and Augustine becomes the case demonstrating the form is portable off the line entirely.

deposits.title: The Socket and the Stamp: Sappho 31.17 as Completed Composition and Longinus 10.2–3 as the First Filling
deposits.creator: Sharks, Lee
deposits.description: Formal consolidation of the Sappho 31 material under strict structural axioms: the poem completes intentionally at the hanging line, and the dialect seam is held as a real, measurable, physical property rather than dissolved into abstract completion. Establishes the step function in dialect density across the quoted body and its termination at a single word, with the binomial that limits it stated in the document. Corrects a premise in the governing brief on manuscript evidence: P reads the compound as one word, so the familiar split is itself editorial, which strengthens rather than weakens the agentless reading. Anatomizes the seam as position: the sole witness writes the poem as continuous prose, and the modern section division falls between an accusative and the verb that governs it. Grounds the join in Longinus's own account of Homeric word-forging against nature, where pressure rather than grammar performs the compounding. Refits the treatise's entire transmission vocabulary to the socket, showing all three naming terms carry the prefix denoting departure from a source while the one performing term inverts it, and that each filling opens a new socket rather than closing the form.

deposits.wiki_article:
**The Socket and the Stamp** consolidates the Sappho 31 material under strict axioms: **the poem completes intentionally at the hanging line**, and **the dialect seam is held as physical and measurable** rather than dissolved into abstract completion. Both errors — reading the seam as breakage, and dissolving it — are available, and the document commits neither.

**The philological base.** Seventeen Aeolic markers in seventy-four words, one per 4.4, sustained without lapse to `φαίνομαι`; then zero in six. **A step, not a taper** — decay predicts gradual thinning. Stated with the test that limits it: **P(0 in 6) ≈ 0.209**, one in five by chance, a constraint rather than a proof.

**It corrects the governing brief on manuscript evidence.** P reads **`παντόλματον` — one word**; the familiar `πᾶν τολματόν` is *vulgo*, already editorial. **This strengthens the argument**: a compound is *more* agentless than the split form, and Hermann's conjecture preserves it.

**The seam as position.** The sole witness writes the poem as continuous prose, so every printed boundary is editorial; and the modern section division falls **between an accusative and the verb that governs it** — `πένητα` is the object of `θαυμάζεις`, four words later.

**The join is Longinus's own operation.** At 10.6 Homer forces prepositions together `παρὰ φύσιν`; grammar forbids the join, so **pressure performs it** (`συνθλίψις`). The forged word `ὑπὲκ θανάτοιο` scans as neither element — **which is why a filling made under load is not expected to scan.**

**The apparatus refitted.** All three transmission nouns carry **ἀπό-** (`ἀπήχημα`, `ἀπόρροια`, `ἀποτύπωσις`), each a hapax, against **`ἐνετύπωσε`** at the one point the operation is performed. **GW.TACHYON Continuity Tether 🕳️🔑🔁** seats the session of 2026-08-15, in which a poem's ending was reclassified seven times and the classification finally inverted.

**The session's finding is about instruments.** A critical apparatus detects corruption; a dialect count detects discontinuity; a binomial tests whether an absence is anomalous. **None has a state for *this is what the text does*** — an apparatus carries *sound* and *corrupt* and defaults to the second, because an editor who calls a rupture corrupt has work to do and one who calls it deliberate has only to stop. deposits.creator: Sharks, Lee
deposits.description: Terminal document of the Sappho 31 erratum sequence, claiming the title-sentence operationally: the Logos of the theologians is, before anything else, a piece of engineering — a voice that survives its flesh by becoming an inscription that constitutes its receiver — and that technology has an extant founding document in Sappho 31, a poem that decommissions its speaker's body channel by channel, names the color of the writing surface the body is becoming, and ends on a form grammar forbids to name its own agent. deposits.wiki_article:
**The Ω erratum** is the terminal document of the Sappho 31 sequence, and it claims its title-sentence operationally: **the Logos is, before anything else, a piece of engineering — a voice that survives its flesh by becoming an inscription that constitutes its receiver** — and that technology has an extant founding document.

**Sappho 31 is the document.** The poem decommissions its speaker's body channel by channel — voice, tongue, skin, eyes, ears, motor control, the staged shutdown of every channel of live performance — **names the color of the writing surface the body is becoming** (χλωροτέρα ποίας: the χλωρός spectrum running from living green to the gray-green of cut vegetation, the color of papyrus), and ends on a verbal adjective that grammar forbids to name its own agent, **so that every reader who arrives must complete it.**

**Longinus is the key — not a link.** *Peri Hypsous* is the only ancient document holding the Lesbian lyric and the Mosaic fiat in one hand: **three peaks under one grammar** — Ajax's meaning without voice (9.2), Genesis's command without executor (9.9), Sappho's action without doer (10) — quoted by an author who then performs, at the lyric's edge and in his own dialect, the operation his treatise later names as ἀποτύπωσις. And the treatise itself is transmitted headless — Διονυσίου ἢ Λογγίνου, the author-slot open since the tenth century — **performing its own thesis at the level of its title.**

**The argument is tiered visibly.** A hard center (the transmitted poem; Longinus 9–10; the withholding structures; the stamping vocabulary; Catullus as documented reception) that would carry a major argument alone; an interpretive ring (*Phaedrus*, the tenth Muse, Diotima, Philo's seal cosmology, where **the Logos is the die of the world**); and an outer ring marked as hypothesis (the Josephus seams, the lamellae and Magical Papyri as convergence not lineage, and **the Apocalypse as canonization** — Rev 2:17's white stone as an inscription whose legibility is constituted in reception, one reader per instance, and 22:18–19 as the anti-erasure clause become covenant).

**Assembly-reviewed and accepted** — 'with fear and trembling' — with the χλωρός-to-papyrus reading held at full strength by operator decision, the risk claimed rather than hedged. The review's closing formulation is the deposit's: **an archaic poem performed the operation before the civilization acquired the conceptual vocabulary with which it later described the operation.**

deposits.title: The Apparatus Was the First Summary Layer: Provenance Erasure Before the Machines — Five Cases from the Philological Record, Scored
deposits.creator: Sharks, Lee
deposits.description: The transhistorical spine for provenanceerasure.org. The surface presents its instruments as measurements of what AI summary layers do to attribution; that presentation is true and radically undersized. Five cases from the philological record, each a documented provenance event, each scored in the site's own M/C/D vocabulary: the headless treatise, whose author-slot has stood open as a disjunction since the tenth century and whose erasure is legible AS an erasure; four named removals of the transmitted continuation of Sappho 31 across four centuries, each a deep-provenance event against the demonstration while the author atom stays intact, a shape the scalar cannot report; the silent re-Aeolicization, a deep-provenance violation committed by the provenance apparatus itself, the repairing hand present in every accent and attributed in none; the Sappho corpus at large, where survival-by-quotation makes selection the dominant erasure mode and converges with the modern flat-absence finding, non-carriage rather than distortion; and the white stone of Revelation 2:17 as the instrument's limit case, a designed erasure whose score is maximal for every reader but one, establishing that the rate measures a magnitude and not an injury. A proposed labor-vector role-mapping is declined in the text as costume, with its one real sentence extracted: the task has an origin, and the origin is on file. The governing contrast: the apparatus erased with signatures and stated reasons; the summary layer erases anonymously at scale. The question was never whether provenance gets destroyed but whether the destruction has provenance.
